attempted_claim: Let M_Davis be the Davis closed orientable arithmetic hyperbolic 4-manifold, the unique torsion-free normal index-14400 quotient of the compact Coxeter simplex group [5,3,3,5] characterized by Ratcliffe-Tschantz, and let iota be the explicit orientation-reversing reflection involution of the 120-cell side-pairing whose fixed set descends to a candidate closed 3-dimensional suborbifold. Prove or disprove that M_Davis contains an embedded closed orientable totally geodesic hyperbolic 3-manifold arising as the descent of the fixed-point set of iota and separating M_Davis. A complete answer must either exhibit the embedded totally geodesic hypersurface with a torsion-free facet-stabilizer and embeddedness certificate, or prove that no such descent is embedded/totally geodesic (e.g. by exhibiting a stabilizer torsion or self-intersection obstruction).
decisive_failure: The lane proved the conditional descent half of the target and eliminated torsion and self-intersection obstructions, but the orientability and separating clauses depend irreducibly on the explicit Davis side-pairing group K, which was unobtainable in-lane: no pairing matrices exist locally, the controlled literature channel failed on an infrastructure error, and blind index-14400 computation exceeds bounded resources. No emergent finding is claimed because the proved lemma is standard material whose originality cannot be checked. All working notes and verification scripts are preserved in output/WORKLOG.md and output/artifacts/.
